title: ProgressionTools
description: Tool progression with XP/leveling—turn grinding into satisfying long-term progression.
body:
# ProgressionTools

ProgressionTools makes tools feel like “your gear”, not disposable items. Players gain XP through real gameplay and build long-term progression that rewards dedication. It’s the perfect loop for servers that want professions, grinding, and progression—without feeling repetitive or pointless.

# Highlights:

XP + leveling for tools through normal gameplay

Progression that fits survival, RPG, and economy servers

Great synergy with enchants, quests, and shops

Perfect for: profession servers, RPG survival, long-term gameplay loops.

# Why you’ll love it

Players stop replacing tools constantly—tools become their gear

Grinding gets purpose: every action contributes to progression

Works perfectly with RPG economies and professions

# Features

XP sources and leveling for tools through normal gameplay

Config-driven balancing and progression pacing

Great synergy with enchants, quests, shops, classes

# Setup

Install the plugin

Configure XP sources + progression values

Adjust rewards/bonuses for your server economy

Reload and test with real gameplay

# Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Great with: Progression, Enchant, Quest, Shop, NPC, custom items
